mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_conversation (tenant_id, owner_user_id, agent_id, agent_version_id, channel, biz_ref_type, biz_ref_id, channel_conversation_id, title, title_source, cli_session_ref, executor_id, status, last_turn_at, archived_at, deleted_at, version) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{ownerUserId}, #{agentId}, #{agentVersionId}, #{channel}, #{bizRefType}, #{bizRefId}, #{channelConversationId}, #{title}, #{titleSource}, #{cliSessionRef}, #{executorId}, #{status}, #{lastTurnAt}, #{archivedAt}, #{deletedAt}, 0)
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM agent_conversation WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND channel = 'PLATFORM_ASSISTANT' AND owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
AND archived_at IS NOT NULL
AND archived_at IS NULL
AND (title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR channel_conversation_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY last_turn_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
